title: Citizens' groups announce protest march to CBI office in Kolkata
seoTitle: Kolkata march to CBI office over RG Kar case

tea.why: Citizens' groups announced a protest march in Kolkata to demand accountability from the CBI regarding the RG Kar rape-murder case.
tea.want: Demand accountability from the CBI, act on evidence, and bring conspirators to justice following the bail of the former principal.
tea.changed: Oct 24: Citizen groups Voice of Abhaya and Voice of Women announced a protest march to the CBI office on November 12.

summary: In Kolkata, citizen groups 'Voice of Abhaya' and 'Voice of Women' have announced a protest march to the CBI office scheduled for November 12. The demonstration will begin at RG Kar Medical College and Hospital. Organisers have called on citizens, particularly women, to join the streets to demand that the CBI act on evidence and hold accountable those responsible for withholding or suppressing evidence in the RG Kar rape-murder case. The announcement follows criticism over the bail granted to the former principal of the hospital in a corruption case, with the victim's parents expressing outrage over the handling of the investigation and demanding action against officials involved.
demands: Act on evidence in the case
Identify and bring main conspirators to justice
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Citizen groups Voice of Abhaya and Voice of Women announced a protest march to the CBI office for November 12.
